cleric.title: Grace Period + Cleric cover: no N1 visit
cleric.body: If Grace Period is active, Cleric cannot Barrier another player on N1. To keep this cover, stay home instead of making a visible visit with your real role. A legal nonvisiting ability is a separate choice. If Grace Period is off, this specific N1 restriction does not apply.

bodyguard.title: Grace Period + Bodyguard cover: no N1 visit
bodyguard.body: If Grace Period is active, Bodyguard cannot make a protective visit on N1. To keep this cover, stay home instead of making a visible visit with your real role. A legal nonvisiting ability is a separate choice. If Grace Period is off, this specific N1 restriction does not apply.

crusader.title: Grace Period + Crusader cover: no N1 visit
crusader.body: If Grace Period is active, Crusader cannot Fortify another player on N1. To keep this cover, stay home instead of making a visible visit with your real role. A legal nonvisiting ability is a separate choice. If Grace Period is off, this specific N1 restriction does not apply.

oracle.title: Oracle is astral: a visible visit contradicts this cover
oracle.body: Aegis leaves no ordinary visit for Tracker or Lookout. Your real Douse or direct book attack can still be observed even if you claim Oracle. Choose this cover when your actual action also fits no ordinary visit. Grace Period disables N1 Aegis.

trapper.title: Trapper cover: build at home before placement
trapper.body: A fresh Trapper normally builds on N1 and cannot place a trap on another player yet. A visible N1 visit is not explained by that build, even when Grace Period is off. Check enabled controls before claiming construction succeeded; do not invent an N1 placement.
